title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Respected Sir, I am working in Japan temporally for 4 months. We are 4 Muslims hear. Can we 4 of us perform Jumma Namaz as masjid is far off from this place and we don?t know any masjid close to our place. 1) I want to know the procedure to offer Jumma namaz and need necessary kuthbah if required. 2) Is Arabic kuthbah is must for Jumma or can we give kuthbah in local/understandable English language 3 )If you give me urdu/English and audio kuthba it will be great. 4) Should we offer complete 4 rakat namaz or kasar. Kindly provide the information Thanks and regards! 2160 views Q. Assalamualaykum, Basicllay am from Hyderabad India, and Iam a follower of Hanafi mazhab. Currently am residing in Saudi Arabia for Job The calarification which i need is as follows: Here in Saudi Arabia on Friday , Azaan is recited well in advance at around 10.45 am whereas Zohar time starts around 11.50, when we reach Masjid at around 11.30 i find all people praying sunnah, i find it difficult that wether i can also prey the Jumae sunnah at 11.30am whereas time starts only at 11.50am, if i do not prey at 11.30, Imam starts Qutab-e- Jumah at 11.45, hence my sunnah is getting lost. Please guide me what shall i do. 2229 views Q. Assalamuelekum I want to know about Juma ki Nawaz. I am living in Chennai. Earlier I was serving in Indian Air Force. At Air Force Camp it is training centre and there are more than 80 Muslim Trainees, who have been provided One big room for praying Salat. from last 20 yrs they were offering salat of Juma also inside Air Force camp. But All five time prayer is not regular in that room with Imam. These Air force trainees also can not go out of gate for offering salat of juma. Now my question is that whether Juma ki nawaj is farz on them,because due to restriction of Militry Service they can not go out in city and offer Juma salt.What they can offer Juma salat inside the camp or there any restriction according to Shariet and Islam, Or Zohar Nawaz is better for them .I approched the Local Mufti also Who is also from Darululoom Deoband, he says you ask this to Darool uloom Deoband it will be better, So Hazarat it is my request what is Fatwa says for these people, 3452 views Q. Assalamoalaikum. Wht is d ruling of eid salaat 4 women? Is it wajib, or sunna? Do thy have to pray in musjid or eidgah? In wht case, cn she pray at hme? 2392 views Q. EID PRAYERS FOR WOMEN 5140 views Q. I am staying at a place (city) from where masjid is very far, it is in another city and takes aroud 1 hour to go by train. I am not sure whether there is any mosalla or parayer hall in my city or not, what should i do for JUMA namaz. I have one more friend with me, so we are two in number. Presently we are offering Zohar namaz with jamat (2 person), we also say Azaan and Iqamat before namaz. Please suggest if this is correct or any change is required. 2713 views Q. I will be thankful to you if you kindly define EIDGAH and enlighten me about the following: 1. Can we conduct Eid prayers in a place owned by a Muslim? 2. Can we conduct Eid prayers in a place owned by a non-Muslim? 3. Is it permissible to make a place Eidgah for one or two years where a building is to come up later on? 4. Can Eid prayers be conducted at different times in a mosque as well as in a nearby place owned by a non-Muslim with his/her permission? 2681 views Q. jume ki namaaz main sunnate muakkda kitni hai or us ki padhne ki tarteeb kya hai? 8478 views Q. Ruling about offering salah after Imam has stood for Jumuah Khutba 3128 views Q. Is it permissable to give khutba in any other language besides arabic? If someone is doing that what we must do? 4649 views Q. I have some questions, plz help me in them.. 1. After eid prayers, doing musafaha and hugging each other is a bidaat.. But my frnds and relatives feel that im insulting them by doing so bcoz they dont have knowledge abt this.. Plz help me how to create awareness and finishing this bidaat in our surroundings.? When we meet someone one day after eid and we havent met for long, can we hug each other..? Although the other person's intention is greeting for eid.. Plz explain in detail.. 2. In our area there are two deobandi aalims.. *One says musafaha and hugging after eid is bidaat, *doing joint dua after faraz namaaz is bidaat, *doing ibadat in masjid during taakhraats is bidaat, *finishing quran in taraweeh on the 26th day of ramzan as bidaat.. While the other aalim says and does the complete opposite.. Plz tell me which one is right.? If the first one is right, is he right in all the matters.. Plz explain in detail.. Its very confusing for a common man when aalims from the same Khankha tell two opposite things in the same matter.. Cant you not regulate what the aalims from your university are preaching and following.? If i can do something to create awareness abt this plz direct me to do so.. I wud be very grateful for your reply and hope it'll solve all my above problems.. Jazakallahu khaer.. 6026 views
